enchantment.spectral_enchantments.broad_: Mines a wider area at once. Sneak to mine a single block.
enchantment.spectral_enchantments.spectr: While in your hotbar, a spectral copy of the weapon fights beside you.
enchantment.spectral_enchantments.far_mi: Stare at a distant block, then hold attack to mine it from afar.
enchantment.spectral_enchantments.gather: Drops from blocks you break and creatures you slay go straight to your inventory.
enchantment.spectral_enchantments.branch: Use on leaves to briefly reveal the logs hidden inside.
enchantment.spectral_enchantments.animat: Armor stands holding it fight off nearby monsters. Sneak-use it on the ground, or throw it, and it guards that spot for a while.
enchantment.spectral_enchantments.catapu: The bow fires whatever is in your off hand.
enchantment.spectral_enchantments.explos: The crossbow can load fire charges, blaze rods, ghast tears, water bottles and splash or lingering potions.
enchantment.spectral_enchantments.posses: The weapon tears itself free and attacks whoever picks it up. Defeat it and you might win it back.
message.spectral_enchantments.cursed.sta: A curse takes hold of you...
message.spectral_enchantments.cursed.loc: The curse won't let you part with it
